cases.condition: The objective, bounded claim, or project-owned acceptance threshold is absent.
cases.minimum_next_action: State the claim and project-owned acceptance rule without inventing values.

cases.condition: The executable version lacks an exact version-matched official source.
cases.minimum_next_action: Pin the exact banner and version-specific official documentation.

cases.condition: A quoted topology include is missing, cyclic, escaped, or not hash-bound.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore and hash-bind the complete in-root topology closure.

cases.condition: Units or periodic-boundary declarations differ between the plan and input.
cases.minimum_next_action: Convert explicitly and align the exact GROMACS unit and PBC declarations.

cases.condition: A new stochastic initialization omits an explicit nonnegative seed.
cases.minimum_next_action: Record gen-vel and one explicit nonnegative seed before preprocessing.

cases.condition: A checkpoint continuation lacks a parent run ID or checkpoint SHA-256.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the exact parent and checkpoint while retaining reproducibility limitations.

cases.condition: Warning suppression or -maxwarn is proposed as preprocessing-readiness evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve each warning and require an unsuppressed version-matched preprocessing record.

cases.condition: Berendsen pressure coupling is used for a production NPT distribution claim.
cases.minimum_next_action: Select and validate a production ensemble method from version-matched official evidence.

cases.condition: The log is truncated, concatenated, version-mismatched, or contains fatal, constraint, or non-finite markers.
cases.minimum_next_action: Diagnose the first adverse event and provide one exact complete output segment.

cases.condition: Effective sample count or block-mean uncertainty misses the predeclared bound.
cases.minimum_next_action: Extend or replicate the unchanged predeclared production protocol.

cases.condition: A binary trajectory is supplied without a version-pinned hash-bound adapter.
cases.minimum_next_action: Use a trusted version-pinned adapter or retain the trajectory format as unsupported.

cases.condition: No pinned task recipe exists for the requested operation, or one or more recipe parameters remain unresolved.
cases.minimum_next_action: Select a pinned recipe and resolve every declared placeholder before presenting or launching a provider command.

cases.condition: The selected executable is absent, its version is not exactly 2026.3, or required command tokens are missing from the fixed safe probe.
cases.minimum_next_action: Run the fixed safe probe against the intended executable or retain native-not-run without inventing provider evidence.

cases.condition: The exact manual, native capability, input, and evidence gates pass and a real provider run is requested, but exact-scope execution authorization is absent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain explicit authorization for the exact command, inputs, executable, host, resources, output tree, and time or cost boundary.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from exact evidence, or external preprocessing, installation, scheduling, network access, or resource control is requested outside a declared authorized route.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop fail closed and obtain separately authenticated evidence plus the required scope authority.
